description: Check the status of pending outbound emails blocked by the outbound guard. You can list all your pending emails or get details of a specific one. You CANNOT approve or reject — only the owner can do that.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

action.description: Action to perform (list or get only — approve/reject require owner)

name: manage_pending_emails
